افتتحتن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَتَحْتُنَّ (iftataḥtunna) /if.ta.taħ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# اُفْتُتِحْتُنَّ (uftutiḥtunna) /uf.tu.tiħ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
